items.question: Is the Free plan really free?
items.answer: Yes. Free includes 50 workflows, 200 actions, 20 WhatsApp messages, 20k AI tokens, 1 AI agent and 1 member. No credit card required. It's functional, not a demo — you can build real production automations.

items.question: Is there a minimum contract period?
items.answer: No. All paid plans are monthly and you can cancel anytime. Annual plans get 17% off (equivalent to ~2 months free).

items.question: What counts: messages or conversations?
items.answer: We bill per actual unit: one WhatsApp message (inbound OR outbound) = 1 meter unit. That's different from Meta's '24-hour conversation' model. We chose messages because it's what's actually consumed — making your bill 100% predictable with zero surprise. Meta still charges their own business-initiated conversation fees (we pass through at cost, no markup).

items.question: What if I exceed the included quota?
items.answer: You keep running. Overage is charged per unit, in real time, at transparent prices: R$ 0.01 per extra workflow, R$ 0.06 per extra WhatsApp message, R$ 0.08 per 1,000 extra AI tokens, R$ 2.00 per extra GB. No cutoff, no fine, no surprise.

items.question: Can I change plans anytime?
items.answer: Yes. Upgrade is instant with pro-rata charge. Downgrade applies next cycle with automatic credit.

items.question: Any additional cost for WhatsApp Cloud API?
items.answer: Catalisa does NOT add markup over Meta's fees — unlike several competitors that add 20% markup. Meta charges per business-initiated conversation (per their official pricing). User-initiated conversations are free for the first 1,000/mo on Meta's side.

items.question: How does the free trial work?
items.answer: Starter has a 15-day trial. Growth and Professional have 7-day trials. You get 100% of the plan features, no credit card required. At the end, choose to continue or go back to Free.

items.question: How does support work?
items.answer: Free: community forum. Starter: email during business hours. Growth: priority with 8h SLA. Professional: priority with 4h SLA + dedicated Slack channel. Enterprise: 24/7 with dedicated account manager and custom SLA.

items.question: Can I test before paying?
items.answer: Yes. Start with Free (no credit card) and validate your automation. When you need more volume, upgrade in one click. We also offer personalized demos for larger operations.

items.question: Do prices include taxes?
items.answer: Displayed prices exclude taxes (ISS, PIS/COFINS in Brazil). Final amount depends on your location and tax regime. We automatically issue NFS-e (electronic service invoices) for Brazilian companies.
